name.full: GitLab link unfurling for Microsoft Teams

description.short: Preview GitLab merge requests, issues and epics in Teams.
description.full: Adds a card for pasted GitLab merge request, issue and epic links. By default, details stay in GitLab. If your administrator enables metadata previews, details fetched using the sender's GitLab account are shared with everyone who can read the Teams message.

commands.title: Disconnect GitLab
commands.description: Disconnect your GitLab account from this app.
